about.heading: Designed by a teacher, for teachers
paragraphs: Hi, I'm [Your name], a NSW primary teacher. I started The K–6 Studio to give busy teachers practical, beautiful units they can trust, so you can spend less time planning and more time with your students.
Every unit is written for real NSW classrooms, with clear learning intentions, hands-on activities and tasks for a range of learners.
